title: Chroma Bath
summary: Pure non-representational color. No object at all — no blob, no sphere, no horizon, no figure. Eight segments, each a different processing dialect applied to a swirling color field: ink bleed, video feedback, slit-scan, datamosh, refraction, print misregistration, granulation, bleach. There is no black in the piece; the darkest value is a glowing indigo.
visualArc: Ink bleeding in water → feedback tunnel → slit-scan lanes → compression smear → refraction through turning glass → misregistered print → granular shatter and reassembly → everything bleaches to warm white.

segments.label: A — Bleed
segments.onScreen: Cold water, macro. Magenta and acid-lime ink walk into each other by capillary action, hold a vibrating seam, and refuse to make brown.
segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift fades up from silence; volume-pedal swell, no attack, long reverb tail. No percussion. No foley.

segments.geminiOmniPrompt: Photoreal cinematic 8K video, 12 seconds, one continuous shot. Extreme macro on magenta and acid-lime ink bleeding through cold water. Full-frame color field, no objects, no horizon, no figures. Camera drifts slowly left at a constant rate — one move only. Three ink threads unfurl off-center and stop halfway across frame. Where magenta meets lime the boundary holds a hard seam and vibrates; the two colors never mix into brown. Deepest folds glow indigo — no pure black anywhere in frame. Soft halation blooms around the brightest magenta. Fine film grain swims. Nothing resolves into a recognizable shape. No cuts, no new elements enter.

segments.label: B — Feedback
segments.onScreen: The field re-enters itself. A recursive tunnel of cyan and sodium orange, each generation smaller, hotter, and rotated a few degrees, receding forever without arriving.
segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift continues; octave-shifted delay cascade under the swell, tails stacking the way the image stacks.

segments.geminiOmniPrompt: Photoreal cinematic 8K video, 16 seconds, one continuous shot. Full-frame video feedback in cyan and sodium orange — the image re-entering itself, each generation smaller, hotter, and rotated a few degrees, receding toward an off-center vanishing point that never arrives. segments.label: C — Slit-Scan
segments.onScreen: Time smeared across the horizontal. Violet and gold drawn into parallel lanes, a single instant stretched the full width of the frame, the swirl sheared into a comb.
segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift; a long luminous glissando runs the length of the segment, matching the horizontal smear.

segments.label: D — Datamosh
segments.onScreen: The picture is gone but the motion survives. Teal and hot coral macroblocks carry old color into new shapes, smearing where the frame should have refreshed.
segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift first swell; granular synthesis dissolving each sustained steel note into drifting particles under the smear.

segments.geminiOmniPrompt: Photoreal cinematic 8K video, 16 seconds, one continuous shot. A full-frame teal and hot-coral color field degrading through compression failure — datamosh. Motion vectors persist after the picture is gone: chunky macroblocks drag old teal color into new coral shapes in clean rectangular steps, leaving trails that refuse to refresh. Camera performs one slow clockwise roll, no other move. One off-center region stays sharp and untouched for the first half, then dissolves into the smear. Quantization banding appears in the smoothest gradients. Ghost edges of shapes that were never there persist and fade. Dot crawl on the hardest remaining edge. Deepest block pileups glow indigo; no pure black in frame. Nothing resolves into a recognizable object. No cuts.

segments.label: E — Refraction

segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift; delicate flageolet harmonics ringing over the pad as the dispersion opens.

segments.label: F — Misregistration

segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift; the pad thins to a single sustained tone, harmony migrating a semitone under the slip.

segments.label: G — Granulation
segments.onScreen: The field shatters into countable grains. Oxblood and mint drift as a cloud, then reassemble into a swirl that is almost, but not quite, the one they left.
segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift tail begins; granular mist of the steel note, reforming imperfectly — the picture and the bed do the same thing here on purpose.

segments.label: H — Bleach
segments.onScreen: Every hue the piece has spent arrives at once and cancels into a single warm white. One last swirl turns inside the white and goes still. The indigo is the last thing to leave.
segments.musicCue: Deep Space Drift reverb tail only, no new notes. Lets the room run out. Optional Continuity Voice after full white — see notes.

segments.geminiOmniPrompt: Photoreal cinematic 8K video, 14 seconds, one continuous shot. A full-frame color field bleaching out: every remaining saturated hue arrives and cancels into a single warm overexposed white. Camera pulls back slowly, one move only. One faint swirl keeps turning inside the white, readable as a difference in warmth rather than hue; it completes one rotation and stills. A thin glowing indigo rim survives in the lower corners longer than anything else, then fades last. Heavy halation spreads across the whole frame. Film grain stays visible in the white. Vignette softens but never darkens to black. No objects, no text, nothing resolves. No cuts. End on warm white, still grained, still faintly moving.
